data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Ree is derived from the word 'Rhea,' meaning 'flowing river' or 'mother goddess.' In the Bible, Ree could be derived from the Hebrew word 'Ra'anan,' meaning 'exalted, strong, or watchful.'. The name Ree carries the meaning “Meadow, clearing, or strong one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ree usually hope their child will grow to embody meadow, clearing, or strong one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
